The '''Blair Cluster''' was a vast [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
[[File:Blairbriefing.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] briefing screen showing the blockade of the Blair cluster]]
The Blair Cluster was the first region targeted in [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn]]'s pacification campaign, [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces set up a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] in order to trap any transport vessels traversing the cluster. The [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'' used its [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well generators]] to create a [[Mass shadow/Legends|mass shadow]] that forced ships to drop out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and also prevented ships from escaping. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] launched the modified [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] of [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] to harry the targeted transports and shuttles into surrendering.
